metadata.title: Who is scheduled tribe in India | कौन है जनजाति, कैसे तय होता है
metadata.description: India's 10 percent of total population is tribal living in many states. The Constitution of India has some special provisions to protect the identity of the scheduled tribes. it also gives special rights to the tribal population to protect their land and livelihood. The government of India is mandated by the constitution to spend certain percentage of the budget on the development of tribals and tribal areas. But till date there is no clear definition of scheduled tribe in the country. It's a lengthy and complicated process to give a community tribal status in India.
